title: Bring core's total Rust under 50,000 lines
goal: Vision: V-9. CEO 2026-11-19: "susi core total line under 50k. make the decisions, do not prompt or ask ceo. go." Core's first-party Rust (runtime, tests and tooling; no vendored source) is 117,968 lines, 73,400 of them the xtask development and release tooling. Move xtask whole to Susi Commercial Apps (tools/core-xtask, T-CLAUDE50K-1 there) and delete it from core, keeping core's Linux link script under toolchain/, so the total falls to about 44,700. No capability is dropped: the tools run from a core checkout, and core names them.

reuse.searched: Core's own xtask, transplanted whole; precedent: the unsafe ratchet's tools already moved to Susi Commercial Apps and run against a core checkout.

progress: 2026-11-19: Susi Commercial Apps' copy is built and tested (tools/core-xtask); core's deletion waits for T-CLAUDE25K-3 to release its xtask/ and toolchain/ scopes.
